Krea2Bausteine.description: Picks two persons, a scene and a style from the saved blocks. New entries appear only after a refresh (R).

Krea2ExpressionBuilder.description: Composes a facial expression. Wire the output into the 'expression' input of Photoshoot Build Prompt and place it with {expression} in the text — as far forward as possible.

Krea2Identity.description: Outputs the reference images of a person as one batch, plus a strength that follows the framing: full up close, nearly off on a wide shot. Wire it into a face adapter (InstantID, PuLID, IP-Adapter FaceID, ...) — this pack does not ship one.

Krea2IdentitySave.description: Stores reference images of a person under her name, at most eight. 'only when empty' writes only while no reference exists yet — that way the first run of a series seeds the identity and every later run uses it. The image passes through unchanged.

Krea2PersonBuilder.description: Builds the person as English text. 'person' is always the full description; 'person_data' is the raw values as JSON for the Photoshoot, which shortens them per camera framing.

Krea2PersonLoad.description: Outputs the text of a saved block.

Krea2PersonSave.description: Stores the text under a name. Flip the switch to 'save', run once, then switch it back. New names appear in the loading node only after a refresh (R).

Krea2Photoshooting.description: Varies camera, pose, expression and aspect ratio across a whole series. The person is optional via 'person_data' and gets shortened per framing. 'person_data' and 'camera_label' at the end are for optional extension packs. The seed is the run counter, not the source of randomness.

Krea2PoseBuilder.description: Composes a body pose. Wire the output into the 'pose' input of Photoshoot Build Prompt and place it with {pose} in the text — as far forward as possible.

Krea2PromptJoin.description: Replaces {person1} {person2} {person3} {camera} {pose} {expression} {scene} {style} {extra}. Recommended: {camera}, {scene}, {person}, {pose}, {extra}, {expression}, {style}. The German spellings still work. {extra} is for extension packs. Without placeholders: camera and scene before the person.

Krea2PromptLoad.description: Outputs the text of a saved block.

Krea2PromptSave.description: Stores the text under a name. Flip the switch to 'save', run once, then switch it back. New names appear in the loading node only after a refresh (R).
